# How does the Internet Work?

The Internet is a massive global network of interconnected computers and devices that communicate by sending data to each other using a shared set of rules. When you visit a website, your device sends a request that travels through multiple routers and networks until it reaches the server hosting that site, which then sends the data back to your screen. This exchange happens through a system of protocols ΓÇömost notably TCP/IPΓÇö that break data into small packets, route them across the network, and reassemble them at the destination.
